desc: Derive exact \(O(n^2)\) formulas for each possible number of additional center copies while preserving exactly two selected indices on each side.
Handle the one-additional-center case, including cross-side duplicate correction.
Handle two, three, and four additional-center cases using frequency counts and index combinations.
Implement incremental left/right frequency maintenance and modular arithmetic.
Validate the counting logic against the provided examples and edge cases.
